name: dropl
description: Create client-editable photo and video galleries from Cursor or Claude Code, then embed them.
long_description: Dropl MCP lets AI coding agents set up Dropl for client websites: create client sites and showcases (embeddable photo and video galleries), upload whole folders of media with categories, fetch embed code for HTML, Next.js, WordPress, Webflow, and Framer, manage collections like menus, inventory, and events, and work through client feedback by fixing it in code, replying, and marking it done. Clients then update their own photos and videos from a phone, without a CMS.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Shows the connected Dropl account, user, role, and API key (name, prefix, scopes, site restriction) plus the web app URL.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: Lists the client sites (one per client website) this connection can reach, with their domains and the plan's site allowance.

tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Creates a client site: the home for one client website's showcases, videos, collections, and feedback.

tools.name: list_showcases
tools.description: Lists a client site's showcases (embeddable photo and video galleries), newest first, with item counts.

tools.name: create_showcase
tools.description: Creates a showcase: an embeddable photo/video gallery the client can update from their phone.

tools.name: get_showcase
tools.description: Summarizes a showcase: settings, item counts by status and kind, categories with counts, photos without alt text, and failed items.

tools.name: list_showcase_items
tools.description: Pages through a showcase's items in display order: id, kind, status, file name, local upload path, alt text, and categories.

tools.name: update_items
tools.description: Sets alt text and adds/removes categories on many showcase items in one call.

tools.name: update_showcase
tools.description: Changes a showcase's title, layout, grid fit, category filter tabs, or items per page.

tools.name: create_category
tools.description: Adds a category (a filter tab) to a showcase.

tools.name: tag_items
tools.description: Adds and/or removes the same categories on many showcase items (photos or videos) at once.

tools.name: upload_photos
tools.description: Uploads local photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC; up to 20 MB each) into a showcase, straight to storage.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: Lists videos in a client site's library (newest first), optionally filtered by a title search.

tools.name: upload_videos
tools.description: Uploads local videos to a client site's video library in resumable parts, for streaming playback without YouTube or Vimeo.

tools.name: add_videos_to_showcase
tools.description: Adds existing library videos to a showcase.

tools.name: get_embed_code
tools.description: Returns the official embed snippet for a video or a showcase, plus where and how to paste it (HTML, React/Next.js, WordPress, Webflow, Framer).

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Shows storage and bandwidth used against the plan's limits this period, and whether uploads or playback are suspended.

tools.name: plan_migration
tools.description: Scans a local folder without uploading and proposes how to bring it into Dropl: categories, counts and sizes, unsupported files, and upload batches.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Lists a client site's collections (menus, inventory, events, …) with item counts, last website read, and the plan's limits.

tools.name: get_collection_schema
tools.description: Reads a collection's current fields, schemaVersion, and site time zone, including edits made in the dashboard.

tools.name: plan_collections
tools.description: Dry run: previews creating or changing up to 10 collections on a client site and returns a plain-text diff.

tools.name: apply_collection_plan
tools.description: Creates or changes the collections previewed with plan_collections.

tools.name: add_collection_items
tools.description: Bulk-adds items to a collection with per-item errors keyed by field key.

tools.name: list_collection_items
tools.description: Lists a collection's items, drafts included, with search, status and field filters, sorting, and paging.

tools.name: get_collection_code
tools.description: Returns TypeScript types and a Next.js fetch example generated from the collection's current fields, plus its public items URL.

tools.name: undo_collection_change
tools.description: Undoes the most recent schema change of a collection when no data written since would be lost.

tools.name: list_feedback
tools.description: Lists feedback the client left on their website (comments on elements, text changes, general notes), newest first.

tools.name: get_feedback
tools.description: Gets one feedback request with its full context: page URL, clicked element, device and viewport, screenshots, and the thread.

tools.name: reply_to_feedback
tools.description: Replies in a feedback request's thread as the signed-in user; the client gets the reply by email.

tools.name: update_feedback_status
tools.description: Sets a feedback request to open, in_progress, done, or wont_do.

api_key.title: Dropl API key
api_key.description: Optional. Dropl API key; overrides the saved browser sign-in. Leave blank to use the sign-in saved by `npx -y @dropl/mcp login`.
